strings: r_c0 is the first one to m_c's side when {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/collapse/collapses} in the middle of the camp.
When m_c blinks {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} eyes open, it's to worried Clanmates hovering around {PRONOUN/m_c/object}. It appears that m_c had fainted.
One moment, m_c feels dizzy and sways on {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} feet, the next {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} blinking and staring up at the sky.
It would appear that due to m_c's wasting disease, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} experiencing some risk of fainting.
